description: Exactly at the trigger (60) counts as moist
Dry soil but the tank is empty
Tank empty while soil is moist: alert only
Dry, watered 45 minutes ago (soak time is over)
Dry, daily cap (500 mL) fully used
Dry, only 60 mL left in today's cap: dose is reduced
Very dry: dose capped at 150 mL per watering
Impossible negative reading while looking dry
Frozen sensor: same low value for 2 hours
Dry for 3 hours in a row: water and raise a stress alert
Dry for only 1 hour: water, no stress alert yet
Very wet but only for 10 hours: no alert yet
Humid for 14 hours in a row
Humid for only 6 hours: no alert yet
Frozen sensor and empty tank: fault comes first
Dry, dark and cold at night
Moist soil after a big watering (index 90): do nothing
